subject: Math
prompt: A delivery driver receives a gratuity from each order. On average, the gratuity is $18%$ of the order total. At this rate, which of the following is closest to the gratuity the driver can expect when an order total is $$46.40$?
explanation: Choice B is correct. If the order total is $$46.40$, $18\%$ of the total can be found by multiplying $46.40$ by the decimal conversion of $18\%$, $46.40 \times 0.18 = 8.352$. The exact amount $$8.35$ is closest in value to $$8.00$.
